annotations.title: Suggest a CEP or a street

description: Suggestions for a partial CEP or a street name, with the neighborhood and the city. Up to eight places. A CEP accepts a prefix of 3 to 8 digits, with an optional hyphen after the fifth digit. A street search accepts an optional state (UF) and city. One address represents each CEP; the full lookup returns the others. The reference is CNEFE 2022, and it does not certify the current postal CEP.

cidade.description: City, to limit the street search.

q.description: Partial CEP or street, 3 to 160 characters.

uf.description: State (UF) abbreviation, to limit the street search.
